# Bundled third-party code

## qrcode.js

QR Code Generator for JavaScript, by Kazuhiko Arase. MIT licensed, unmodified.

- Version: 2.0.4
- Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator (`dist/qrcode.js`)
- Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

Used to draw the authenticator provisioning URI as a scannable QR during
enrolment. It runs in the browser and makes no network requests, so the
provisioning secret never leaves the page it was already printed on.
